contract: SKL-2 (A23-49): UseSkill(slot) -> SkillService.Cast: GlobalGap 0.5 s between any two skills (a manual press inside it queued once, an auto cast waits), refusals before MP with Fx SkillPress { Slot, Result }. Q = CombatService.Release (returns true, Released.Slot = "Q"); Z shapes: Line (band Len x Width toward the nearest aimed target, else ahead) and Chain (Range, Jump, Hits, no repeats; no target = NoTarget). Damage D x Mult once a target; pull (manual) / push via MonsterService.Displace (stop 3 in front, / body scale, bosses never, zone rect + leash + ground + walls, shorter steps). DamageWindow: 3 s per pair, player damage 35% (kaiju 8%), Halo heal 30% an ally, Horns steal 3% - Q and Z share it; players only with PvPZX and a manual cast. Slots (A23-71): SkillSlots 0..3 = Config.SkillSlotsFor (Q Lv5 / Z Lv15 / X Lv25, all after a rebirth), never lowered, Fx SkillUnlocked (Q always, Z / X only while the slot's flag is on); no skill before Lv5 (manual, the old Release remote and auto). Auto: Z first by its rule (Min / OrBig / BeforeQIfSpread), never pulls.
limitations: X shapes (Field / Roar / Hop), Guard / Slow / Taunt / MP steal and the X-first auto order are SKL-3: tools/test_skills_x.py (SK1 / SK2 in tools/test_town_quests.py). The client parts (SkillBar buttons, SkillFx looks, the refusal shake / words, the unlock page) are game dev 1's and image dev's. Displace's slide itself (the CFrame loop) is not run offline.
